editorial:
Imagine getting dumped by your husband for a younger woman right in the middle of your life. That is exactly what happens to Alice Washington, a mom who decides she has had enough. Instead of wallowing in sadness, she heads to Smith College to finally finish her degree. You will love the chemistry between Alice and her twenty-year-old roommate, Zoe. They come from totally different worlds, but they bond over their struggles and a shared crush on their handsome poetry professor. It is a feel-good story about starting over and finding yourself when you thought your best years were behind you.

The acting is warm and believable, making you really root for Alice to win. While the pace is a bit slow at times, the funny moments between the roommates keep things moving. It is a sweet movie, though it does follow some predictable patterns. If you enjoy lighthearted stories about female friendship and second chances, you should definitely check this out. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp picture, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night at home.
endingExplained: In the end, Alice learns that her value does not depend on her ex-husband. She finishes her studies and finds a new sense of confidence. After some romantic tension with the poetry professor, she realizes that her personal growth was the real prize. She and Zoe stay close friends, proving that age is just a number. Alice walks away happy and independent, finally living a life that is all about her own dreams.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about starting over and lifelong learning.
